beats.text: Ask an AI to fix a broken form, and it will tell you it's fixed. The page loads. A confirmation appears. But did the user's booking actually get saved, correctly?
Here, the booking page says success. But the database stored the wrong phone number. Nobody notices, unless you check what was saved.

AccessFinish drives the journey in a real browser, then hands the evidence and the source code to NVIDIA Nemotron, on Nebius Token Factory. It is never told the cause. Nemotron finds the hard-coded value, and writes the fix.
beats.say: AccessFinish drives the journey in a real browser, then hands the evidence and the source code to NVIDIA Nemo-tron, on Nebius Token Factory. It is never told the cause. Nemo-tron finds the hard-coded value, and writes the fix.

beats.text: Every fix is built in a fresh, offline sandbox, and checked for real: the saved database row, a fresh browser, and a second customer with a different number. Twenty-seven live runs. Twenty-seven verified fixes, for about a cent each.
Now a real bug from the open-source app. A keyboard user can't reach the date picker at all.
Nemotron makes the date reachable, and the page says the booking is confirmed. But AccessFinish reads the database. Saved for the wrong day. Rejected.
beats.say: Nemo-tron makes the date reachable, and the page says the booking is confirmed. But AccessFinish reads the database. Saved for the wrong day. Rejected.

beats.text: And it shows which code did it. Half a second after the date is typed, the month-change handler fetches unavailable dates, and overwrites what the user typed.
With that evidence, Nemotron fixes the reset, and the right date is saved. But reopening the booking shows today's date. A second bug.
beats.say: With that evidence, Nemo-tron fixes the reset, and the right date is saved. But reopening the booking shows today's date. A second bug.

beats.text: Nemotron fixes that too, building on its best attempt. Verified: saved, reopened in a fresh browser, and the mouse path still works.
beats.say: Nemo-tron fixes that too, building on its best attempt. Verified: saved, reopened in a fresh browser, and the mouse path still works.

beats.text: Across twenty-seven keyboard runs, seventy-seven false booked confirmations were caught. Not one got through.
Fifty-four live runs, for under seven dollars of Nemotron. Fixes that are proven, not promised.
beats.say: Fifty-four live runs, for under seven dollars of Nemo-tron. Fixes that are proven, not promised.

beats.text: AccessFinish. Finish the task. Verify the result.
